page_title: WER 3-1 HAM | Werder Bremen v Hamburger SV 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' Florian Exner is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+12' Werder Bremen take a short corner kick.
90+12' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+11' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+11' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a superb save!

90+5' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Daniel Heuer Fernandes is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
90+5' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+1' 3 - 1 Goal! Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) neatly controls a decent pass from Romano Schmid. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 3:1.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 40000.
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.
90' A superb shot by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Njinmah leaves the pitch and Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) comes on.
89' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly changes the colour of the card shown to Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) to a yellow. Play continues.

87' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Bakery Jatta (Hamburger), but referee Florian Exner must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
85' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
84' That's unlucky! Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
83' Nicolas Capaldo goes off the pitch and Damion Downs (Hamburger) comes on.
82' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
79' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Florian Exner had no choice but to send Philip Otele (Hamburger) off. VAR seen to good effect there!
78' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Philip Otele (Hamburger)! Let's see what he decides.
76' Here is a change. Ransford Konigsdorffer is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Otto Stange (Hamburger).
75' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Bakery Jatta replaces him.
74' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' Looks like Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
73' This is a yellow card! Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
72' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Miro Muheim (Hamburger). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. Hamburger SV earn a corner.
72' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall. Hamburger SV get a corner.

72' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen). Florian Exner saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Hamburger SV are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
71' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
67' It is time for a substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is on for Jens Stage.
66' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Philip Otele (Hamburger) replaces Albert Gronbaek.
62' Hamburger SV quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
61' It's time for a substitution. Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Jovan Milosevic.
60' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
58' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

57' 2 - 1 Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Cameron Puertas. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the top right corner via the woodwork. 2:1!

55' Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off a decent save! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
50' The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the right post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Florian Exner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

41' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Nicolas Capaldo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Robert Glatzel (Hamburger), who beats Mio Backhaus with a brilliant shot into the top left corner. 1:1.

37' 1 - 0 Goooooal! Yukinari Sugawara beats his man and slings in a cross towards Jens Stage (Werder Bremen), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the top right corner from close in. 1:0.
34' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
33' Florian Exner blows his whistle after Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Hamburger SV have a free kick.

33' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

27' A sweet pass finds Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Mio Backhaus is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
26' The cross fools the defence and leaves Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.
21' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
16' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
13' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

11' Justin Njinmah is the provider with a good cross and Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he fires a shot well wide of the right post.

7' Great save! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Daniel Heuer Fernandes.
5' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) gets in a header from the resulting free kick. It lacks accuracy, however, to bother the keeper and the ball goes a few metres wide of the right post.
4' It seemed like Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
1' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Florian Exner will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
